historical_references.context: Raghaad is mentioned as the site of a major battle between the Muslim forces under Caliph al-Mu'tasim and the Byzantine forces under Emperor Romanos I Lekapenos. The battle, fought in 883 CE, ended with a decisive Muslim victory, allowing al-Mu'tasim to secure his control over the region.

historical_references.reference: Ibn al-Jawzi, Tarikh al-Islam, vol. 11, p. 103. 12th century CE. Raghaad was a significant religious center in the Abbasid Caliphate.
